title.zh: 在莱特省La Paz市镇Sta. Ana描笼涯设立国立中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Sta. Ana, Municipality of La Paz, Province of Leyte and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Sta. Ana, Municipality of La Paz, Province of Leyte and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Trường Trung học Quốc gia tại Barangay Sta. Ana, Đô thị La Paz, Tỉnh Leyte, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Sta. Ana เทศบาล La Paz จังหวัด Leyte และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Sekolah Menengah Nasional di Barangay Sta. Ana, Kotamadya La Paz, Provinsi Leyte, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Sta. Ana, Perbandaran La Paz, Wilayah Leyte, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8821_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established a national high school at Barangay Sta. Ana, Municipality of La Paz, Province of Leyte, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
